question: Within a 140 kilometers distance, where can I find a restaurant on the path toward IDESST Sausalito Portuguese Cultural Center, Sausalito, CA from the View Lounge, San Francisco, CA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%View Lounge%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ) AS start_point, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%IDESST Sausalito Portuguese Cultural Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Sausalito%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ) AS end_point WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, start_point.geometry::geography, 140000) AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(start_point.geometry, end_point.geometry)::geography, 1000)) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, start_point.geometry::geography);
